entries.original: Device operations run through the bundled fleet SDK (`bunshin` in eval cells) now fail with a typed error, `{ code, message, next_action }` like the thread tools, instead of an internal transport sentence. The message names the operation and the device, and the code tells a wrong argument (`invalid_arguments`) apart from an offline device (`device_offline`), a policy refusal (`scope_denied`) and a lost connection (`transport_closed`). The relay's own op-result codes pass through unchanged and carry `uncertain` when the device may have run the op. The "no transport" error and a failed connect now say what to do next. ([#13744](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13744))

entries.original: On Windows, background keyboard input that holds Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win while another key goes down is now refused with `BackgroundUnavailable` and nothing sent, instead of being reported delivered while the application received only the bare key. This covers key chords such as `ctrl+k`, bounded key and mouse holds with such keys, and a single character the keyboard layout types with Shift or AltGr (for example `K`, or `@` on a German layout). Send it with `delivery: "foreground"` or use accessibility actions. ([#13734](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13734), fixes [#13297](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/13297))

entries.original: `thread_list` and `omo thread list` now list threads on all of the account's devices in every call, not only with `all_scope`. An ended thread on another device shows as resumable instead of live. The result includes the account's devices: name, platform, kind, online state, last seen, thread count, and whether this listing reached them, so a device that did not answer is named instead of silently missing. `omo thread list --json` now prints that whole result as one object (`threads`, `devices`, `remote_unavailable`) instead of a bare array of threads, and the plain listing names each other device's thread's device and prints one line per device. ([#13394](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13394), fixes [#13392](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/13392))

entries.original: Computer use v3 (fake backend): `inject()` now refuses a scripted failure whose code and reason have no row in the error table, the same check the scenario loader applies, instead of failing later. A capture whose extent is under one whole pixel (an empty size or region, or any length that scales to less than 1 px), or whose scale is zero or negative, or whose size or region is negative, now refuses `CaptureFailed` before allocating instead of returning a 0x0 frame or, for a negative size times a negative scale, a positive one. The fake's source guard now also bans environment reads, including a grouped `use std::{...}` import of the module (on one line or split across lines) and any path into it.
